summary: Brother of John's great-grandmother Florence Pringle, who served in the First World War and married Maria Verena Alles in Indiana; John's great-grand-uncle.
bio:
Joseph Vincent Pringle was born at Plymouth, Luzerne Co., PA, on 24 March 1895, a son of Addison F. Pringle and Catherine E. Heffernan and a brother of John's great-grandmother Florence Pringle. He was still in the family household at Plymouth in 1910. He registered for the draft at Wilkes-Barre during the First World War, and his military service ended on 30 April 1919.

He was living in Wilkes-Barre in 1920 and 1921, and on 10 October 1921 he married Maria Verena Alles (1895–1980) in Blackford County, Indiana. In 1940 he was living in the household of Mary Alles. He died on 30 January 1961.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh (1910 Plymouth census list of Catherine Heffernan Pringle's children)

researchNotes:
Child of Addison F. Pringle and Catherine E. Heffernan, born about 1895, listed in the 1910 census (Plymouth/Larksville) household. He married in New York City in 1915. No further research done.

FamilySearch gives him a birth date of 24 Mar 1895 at Plymouth and a death date of 30 Jan 1961. It records a WWI draft registration at Wilkes-Barre and service ending on 30 Apr 1919, and his marriage on 10 Oct 1921 in Blackford Co., Indiana, to Maria Verena Alles (1895-1980). In 1940 he was in the household of Mary Alles ([R4-S1]). The site says he married in New York City in 1915, but FamilySearch has that NYC marriage for his sister Genevieve.
